title.ko: It is said that … / He is thought to + 동사원형
title.en: It is said that … / He is thought to + infinitive

explain.ko: 보도 수동태는 뉴스나 격식 있는 글에서 ‘~라고 한다, ~인 것으로 알려져 있다’고 말할 때 씁니다. 두 가지 구조가 있습니다. 첫째, It + be + 과거분사 + that절: It is said that he is in Paris. 둘째, 주어 + be + 과거분사 + to부정사: He is said to be in Paris. 과거에 일어난 일은 to have + 과거분사로, 진행 중인 일은 to be + -ing로 씁니다. 자주 쓰는 동사는 say, think, believe, know, report, estimate, expect입니다. 주어를 밝히지 않아도 되고 정보의 출처가 불확실할 때 편리합니다.
explain.en: Reporting passives are used in news and formal writing for 'it is said that …'. Two patterns: It + be + past participle + that-clause (It is said that he is in Paris), and subject + be + past participle + to-infinitive (He is said to be in Paris). Use to have + past participle for earlier events and to be + -ing for ongoing ones. Common verbs: say, think, believe, know, report, estimate, expect. They avoid naming the source.
